scaffold: Scaffold behind the flag “premium.enabled”: no payments. Digital premium content later goes through Apple and Google purchases in the app.

plans.title: Memberships: plans
plans.intro: Plans with names and features in German and English. No price: V1 has no payments.
plans.caption: Plans
plans.error: The plans could not be loaded
plans.empty_body: Add a plan before you grant it to members.

plan_form.key_hint: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens; fixed once created.
plan_form.features_hint: One feature per line, at most 20, each up to 160 characters.

errors.key: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, up to 64 characters.
errors.name: Enter a German name (up to 80 characters).
errors.features: At most 20 features of up to 160 characters each.

entitlements.title: Memberships: entitlements
entitlements.intro: Who holds which plan, granted by whom, with reason, start and end. A revocation stays as history.
entitlements.caption: Entitlements
entitlements.error: The entitlements could not be loaded
entitlements.empty_body: Members you grant a plan show here with plan, period and reason.

grant_form.title: Grant a member
grant_form.body: The grant goes into the audit log with its reason.
grant_form.no_plan_body: You can grant a plan once an active plan exists. Create it under “Plans”.

revoke_dialog.title: Revoke the entitlement of :member
revoke_dialog.body: The plan :plan ends at once. The row stays as history.
